title: Understanding the Kimi Antonelli Salary: How to Convert Hourly Rates to Annual Pay in Australia
description: Learn how to convert hourly rates to annual salary using the 38-hour week formula. Includes National Minimum Wage, casual loading, super, and tax for 2026-27.
salarySummary: Using the National Minimum Wage of $26.44 per hour, a 38-hour week yields $1004.90 per week or $52,254.80 per year before tax, with super paid on top.

faqs.q: How do I convert an hourly rate to annual salary?
faqs.a: Multiply the hourly rate by hours per week and then multiply by 52 weeks. For a 38-hour week, annual gross is hourly × 38 × 52. For example, the National Minimum Wage of $26.44 gives $1004.90 per week and $52,254.80 per year. The same formula works for any rate, including the Kimi Antonelli salary if you know the hourly figure.

faqs.q: What is casual loading and how does it affect my pay?
faqs.a: Casual loading is an extra 25% on top of the base hourly rate, as set by the Fair Work Commission. For the National Minimum Wage, the casual rate is $33.05 per hour. Super is still paid on the base rate plus loading. If you type a base rate into the timesheet, check the 'Add 25% casual loading' box to get the correct casual rate.

faqs.q: How is super and tax for 2026-27?
faqs.a: Super is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top of your gross pay. It stops when earnings reach the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year. Tax uses the 2026-27 resident scale: nil to $18,200, 15% to $45,000, 30% to $135,000, 37% to $190,000, 45% above. Medicare levy is 2% of taxable income. The take-home pay calculator on the site shows after-tax amounts.

bodyMarkdown:
## Converting Hourly Rates to Annual Salary

If you are searching for the **Kimi Antonelli salary** or any other pay figure, the first step is understanding how to convert an hourly rate to an annual salary. In Australia, the standard full-time week is 38 hours. The formula is simple: multiply your hourly rate by 38, then by 52 weeks. This gives your gross annual salary before tax and super.

For example, the National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour. Using the formula: $26.44 × 38 = $1004.90 per week; $1004.90 × 52 = $52,254.80 per year. This is the base rate for award/agreement-free adult employees, set by the Fair Work Commission.

### Award Rates and the National Minimum Wage

Most employees are covered by a modern award, which sets minimum pay rates higher than the National Minimum Wage. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides pay guides for each award. From 1 July 2026, award minimum wages increased by 4.75%. You can find your award’s rates on the [pay guides](/blog) page. If you are award-free, the National Minimum Wage applies.

### Casual Loading and Super

Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the base hourly rate. For the National Minimum Wage, the casual rate is $33.05 per hour ($26.44 × 1.25). Superannuation is paid on top of your ordinary earnings, including casual loading, at 12% for 2026-27. The maximum contribution base is $270,830 per year. Super is not deducted from your pay; it is an additional contribution by your employer.

### Using the Timesheet

The [timesheet](/) on this site lets you enter your base hourly rate. If you are casual, check the box to add 25% casual loading. Do not enter a rate that already includes loading. The tool then calculates your weekly, fortnightly, and annual gross pay, as well as estimated tax and super.

### Fortnightly Pay

Many Australian employers pay fortnightly. To find your fortnightly gross, multiply your weekly pay by 2. For the National Minimum Wage: $1004.90 × 2 = $2009.80 per fortnight. This is useful for budgeting and comparing job offers.

### Tax and Take-Home Pay

Tax is calculated using the 2026-27 resident tax rates: tax-free threshold up to $18,200, then 15% up to $45,000, 30% up to $135,000, 37% up to $190,000, and 45% above that. The Medicare levy is 2% of taxable income. The [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) page shows estimates after tax and Medicare. Note that HELP loans, Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not included in these estimates.

### Example: Kimi Antonelli Salary

If you are looking up the **Kimi Antonelli salary**, you may have an hourly rate in mind. Apply the same formula: hourly × 38 × 52. For instance, if the rate is $30 per hour, annual gross is $30 × 38 × 52 = $59,280. Add 12% super ($7,113.60) for total employment cost. The actual salary may vary based on award, agreement, or negotiation.

### Important Notes

This conversion assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax uses the 2026-27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025-26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026-27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.

For more details, see the [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) and [average pay](/topics/average-pay) pages.
